notes.title: Bug fixing
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I just fixed the following bug:
- If the laser sound is playing while reaching the finish, the laser sound kept playing until the next occurrence of a laser in a later level

Thanks to Bill!B for finding it :]

BR
